findings.capability: 24/7 live monitoring with alert receipt under 2 seconds, response under 60 seconds, and emergency escalation.
findings.health_gap: Health notifications and records show status, but the UI does not yet expose an explicit SLA timer, escalation ladder, or live response-time evidence.
acceptance: 待处理预警显示 SLA 倒计时
dashboard 显示逾期待办/升级数

findings.capability: Action management supports assigning, tracking, completion reporting, and escalating notifications for overdue items.
findings.health_gap: Health 的告警处理更偏列表和状态流转，缺少责任人、到期日、逾期升级和跨部门动作看板的统一呈现。
acceptance: 告警项可设置到期时间
逾期动作出现在统一待办列表

source.name: 位智物联 智慧矿山

findings.capability: Mine operations are shown on one map across 2D/2.5D/3D, with live location, trajectory, geofence, and emergency control.
findings.health_gap: Health 的安全指挥中心还没有同等级的统一地图与空间联动能力，现场位置、轨迹和告警的地图关联偏弱。
acceptance: 地图上能看人员/设备实时位置
告警点能联动地图高亮
支持轨迹回放或分区态势视图

findings.capability: Dashboard widgets can switch between real-time, consolidated, and device views, and include worker status, device status, live events, risk, and map widgets.
findings.health_gap: Health dashboard already有图表，但缺少更标准化的可配置 widget 组合和 worker/device/risk 的一屏聚合模板。
acceptance: dashboard 支持更清晰的模块化 widget 组合
worker status 与 event status 同屏
风险与设备状态的统一摘要卡

source.name: 小视科技 智慧矿山

findings.capability: AI video analysis performs automatic patrol, recognition, warning, push, and assessment with 7x24 unattended monitoring.
findings.health_gap: Health 现有告警链路缺少视频/图片证据和巡检式回放能力，事件闭环更多停留在文本和表格。
acceptance: 告警详情可挂载图片或视频证据
事件时间线可回放关键截图
处置记录可附审计备注
